graphics.title: Proposition 3: Diameter bisecting chord is perpendicular
graphics.description: Circle ABC with diameter CD bisecting chord AB at F and cutting it at right angles.
graphics.text_reference: in it let a straight line CD through the centre bisect a straight line AB not through the centre at the point F; I say that it also cuts it at right angles...
